data.name: Tanvika
data.gender_notes: Tanvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tanu (dazzling, radiant) + Vika (goddess). Derived from the Sanskrit language, Tanvika is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu tradition. This name is associated with the goddesses of love, beauty, and fertility. It symbolizes the inner light and divine grace that every girl embodies. The name Tanvika carries the meaning “Dazzling, Radiant Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Tanvika usually hope their child will grow to embody dazzling, radiant goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Tanvika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dazzling, Radiant Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tanvika total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
